env_files.role: Enterprise directory and seven controlled registers covering base assignments, routes, engagements, organization changes, duty overrides, and same-day control bulletins across campuses and procedures

Controlled revision 6.3 handbook defining source precedence, time-specific bulletin rules, relationship semantics, severity thresholds, exclusions, and audit-reference requirements without listing the final person roster
June review and same-day addendum mixing approved base decisions, active temporary-works changes, later proposals, and out-of-scope records

source_policy.web_usage_note: Closed environment. Solve only from task.txt and env files.

design_notes: The public environment contains no include flag, final roster, final edge list, expected answer, judge field, or scoring file.
The active state requires seven-sheet reconciliation plus policy precedence: base assignment, active duty override, then eligible released control bulletins.
Two role substitutions require every role-based route and engagement endpoint to be refreshed to the active holder.
Temporary reporting, two added escalation routes, and one activated advisory relationship are mixed with 119 plausible but invalid bulletins.
Every dashed and dotted relationship requires a factual register reference in addition to correct endpoints, direction, trigger or mode, and severity.
Grounded Score 2 requires exact current sets and relationship inventories with no unsupported additions; Score 1 normally permits only one bounded defect.
The sole visual-quality VQA and its score criteria are preserved verbatim from the input case.
